The '''''Null Racket''''' was a [[Corvette/Legends|corvette]] [[Captain/Legends|captained]] by the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Sava Matar]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Captain Matar and the ''Null Racket'' operated in the [[Corellian sector/Legends|Corellian sector]]. As the ship was able to outrun [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] vessels, Sava Matar claimed that the ''Null Racket'' was the fastest ship in the sector.<ref name="SWG:TDHSP">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=terminal||Take Down Hardened Space Pirate}} on Corellia</ref> However, in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> [[Reego Hinterstar]]'s [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] crew intercepted the ''Null Racket'' and robbed Captain Matar's cargo. Sava Matar then hired a freelance strike team to track down Hinterstar on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] and retrieve the cargo.<ref name="SWG:TDHSP" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Null Racket'' was mentioned in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TDHSP" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The ''Null Racket'' was mentioned in a mission called "Take Down Hardened Space Pirate" available on [[mission terminal]]s on Corellia.<ref name="SWG:TDHSP" />
